🚀 wavemon | C
🎯 Primary Use Case: Monitoring the status and performance of wireless network interfaces on Linux systems through a text-based user interface.
✨ Key Features: • Real-time monitoring of wireless network devices • Displays signal and noise levels • Shows packet statistics • Provides device configuration and network parameters • ncurses-based interface for terminal display
📖 Summary: wavemon is a C-based, ncurses-enabled monitoring application for Linux that provides real-time insights into wireless network devices. It displays signal and noise levels, packet statistics, device configuration, and network parameters, working with most Linux kernel-supported wireless hardware.
